reasons.plausibility: The proposed addition of Si and C to form in-situ SiC reinforcements in an HEA to improve mechanical integrity while maintaining caloric performance aligns well with known mechanisms of particle reinforcement, though some uncertainty remains about potential local compositional effects.
reasons.testability: A clear comparison of mechanical and caloric properties between the baseline and modified alloys under identical conditions allows for a decisive assessment of the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Strengthening a high-entropy alloy refrigerant while preserving its caloric properties directly addresses a key challenge in solid-state cooling materials, providing a practical research direction.
